papers.title_en: P-BFM: Perceptive Behavioral Foundation Models for Humanoid Control via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Xue Wang, Yitang Li, Yiming Zhang, Siqin Wang, Junhan Sun, Zhihao Liu, Yaojie Shen, Jingbo Yuan, Hao Zhao, Qingdu Li
papers.evidence: 通过无监督强化学习实现人形机器人全身控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人行为基础模型需在多变地形下复用全身技能，但同一行为意图常需不同动作，靠地形配对演示覆盖组合空间代价极高。P-BFM将控制解耦为地形无关的意图与地形条件化的实现：前向-后向表示把运动参考、目标状态和奖励映射到共享意图空间，感知策略再依地形几何实现意图。针对纯隐变量控制丢失全局进展的问题，显式根指令分离朝向与平面速度。最终单一冻结策略在崎岖地形提升运动保真、根控制精度与抗扰恢复，并零样本迁移至Unitree G1。
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) provide humanoids with reusable repertoires of whole-body behaviors; in real-world humanoid control, the same behavioral intent may require fundamentally different motions under different terrain constraints. Covering such variation with terrain-matched demonstrations requires enumerating a combinatorial space of behaviors and terrain geometries. We introduce P-BFM, a perceptive behavioral foundation model that factorizes humanoid control into terrain-invariant intent and terrain-conditioned realization. A forward-backward representation maps motion references, target states, and reward functions into a shared intent space without terrain information, while a perceptive policy learns how to realize each intent under the surrounding terrain geometry. We further identify a complementary limitation of purely latent control: behavioral latents can preserve local motion patterns while losing precise global progress. We therefore introduce Explicit Root Instructions (ERI), which separates global transport (e.g., heading and planar velocity) from behavioral intent, while leaving local whole-body adaptation to the perceptive policy. This decomposition leads to a characteristic capability absent from conventional BFMs: one fixed intent induces different, terrain-appropriate behaviors, including changes in step height, stride, posture, foothold placement, and contacts, without terrain-specific demonstrations. Across challenging terrains, P-BFM improves motion fidelity, root-control precision, and perturbation recovery over strong baselines. A single frozen policy further supports motion tracking, goal reaching, reward inference, teleoperation, and terrain-aware recovery, and transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 using onboard depth sensing.

papers.title_en: From Video to Vision: Learning Generalizable Humanoid Carrying from Human Motion
papers.authors: Ziluo Ding
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人运动控制的强化学习训练框架
papers.tldr: 现有视频/动捕驱动的人形搬运强化学习依赖上层模块实时生成参考轨迹，只能从指定位置搬取物体，空间泛化差且难离开动捕棚。作者提出 MOVER 多阶段 Teacher-Assistant-Student 框架，先重定向视频并增强数据，再分轨迹跟踪、放宽参考运动、Dagger-PPO 蒸馏三阶段训练。蒸馏后策略无需全局位置，可直接用机载 RGB-D 相机感知物体位姿。仿真中成功率提升，并在真实人形上实现无动捕、变位置搬运。
papers.abstract_en: Most existing approaches rely on video or motion-capture data for reinforcement learning (RL) training; however, all of these methods require an upper-level module to generate reference trajectories in real time. In object carrying tasks, the humanoid can only lift objects from designated locations along the reference trajectory, resulting in poor spatial generalization. Moreover, existing policies can only be evaluated inside a motion-capture studio. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MOVER}, a multi-stage, Teacher-Assistant-Student, RL training framework for humanoid object carrying. We first collect data from videos and employ GENMO and GMR to retarget the video data, combining this with data augmentation techniques to generalize the data across objects of varying shapes and sizes. In the \textbf{first stage}, building upon the DeepMimic \cite{peng2018deepmimic} motion-training framework, we train the humanoid to transport objects from specified locations along designated trajectories. In the \textbf{second stage}, we relax the tracking of the reference motion and adjust the reward so that the humanoid learns to transport objects from different positions. In the \textbf{third stage}, we apply a Dagger-PPO distillation method to distill away the proprioceptive position observations and reference joint position of the humanoid. This allows the deployed policy to operate without relying on global position information from a motion-capture system; instead, the humanoid can directly perceive the object's pose from its onboard RGB-D camera to complete the carrying task. We design a series of simulation experiments to compare the success rates across stages (Stages 1 vs. 2) and before versus after distillation. We further transfer the policy to a real humanoid, successfully transporting objects at varying positions in a motion-capture-free setting.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.authors: Qingyu Lan, Zhihao Tian, Zifan Wang, Junwei Liang
papers.evidence: 面向人形全身控制的强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型可多样全身控制，但将预训练控制器迁移到新本体时，运动学与动力学差异导致适配难。TRACE通过向输入输出投影层注入运动学先验并对齐关节标称动力学，再结合编码器蒸馏与低秩强化学习，在精选动作集上以两阶段课程微调。将SONIC从Unitree G1迁移至H2，用1000万帧、单卡约8小时，成功率达96.08%（67,953个评测动作）。该框架以不足从头训练0.1%的GPU时耗实现跨本体复用，并支持真机全身遥操作与下游VLA策略后训练。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.

papers.title_en: Traffic State Prediction and Control Using a Koopman Operator Framework with Polynomial Observables
papers.authors: Shakib Mustavee, Arvind Singh, Shaurya Agarwal
papers.evidence: 用多项式可观测量的Koopman算子框架建模非线性交通动力学
papers.tldr: 面向LWR守恒律交通流的预测与控制，本文提出基于多项式可观测量的Koopman算子框架。Greenshields流密关系启发多项式字典选择，受控动力学在升维坐标下呈双线性结构。基于时空密度快照辨识降阶Koopman模型，并嵌入模型预测控制实现匝道调节。一小时高速实验显示，该控制器将密度保持在Greenshields临界值以下，与非线性PDE-MPC的最大密度差小于1%，在线模型评估成本降低约一个数量级，优于线性化LWR基线。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a Koopman operator framework for modeling and control of traffic flow governed by the Lighthill--Whitham--Richards (LWR) conservation law. We show that the nonlinear dynamics induced by the Greenshields flow--density relation naturally motivate a dictionary of polynomial observables, while the controlled dynamics become bilinear in the lifted Koopman coordinates. A reduced-order Koopman model is identified from spatio-temporal traffic-density snapshots and used as the prediction model in a model predictive control (MPC) framework for ramp metering. The resulting Koopman-MPC is compared with two predictive control baselines that use, respectively, a fixed linearized LWR model and the nonlinear finite-volume LWR model. In a one-hour freeway experiment, the Koopman-based controller maintains the traffic density below the critical Greenshields value and closely reproduces the behavior of the nonlinear PDE-based MPC, with a maximum-density difference below 1%. The Koopman predictor also reduces the mean online model-evaluation cost by approximately one order of magnitude relative to the nonlinear PDE predictor. In contrast, the linearized LWR predictor is computationally cheaper but exhibits substantially larger prediction errors and yields a more conservative metering policy. These results demonstrate that the analytical structure of the nonlinear traffic conservation law can be exploited to construct an interpretable data-driven surrogate for efficient traffic prediction and control

papers.title_en: TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
papers.authors: Zejian Kang, Yifu Luo, Boyang Shen, Jingxuan Li, Zekai Chen, Zekun Shi, Yongxue Xu, Zhenyu Hou, Bingqian Wu, Shaolei Zhang, Wentao Yang, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的人形运动生成与编辑
papers.tldr: 语言驱动的人形机器人动作生成需将模糊指令落地为可修订的具体动作结构。TRACE 面向 Unitree G1，以带类型、可度量的运动学量统一生成与编辑：语言模型从动作监督中预测支撑、根与手部事件，其时间对齐编码与文本共同驱动扩散生成器，并以重力参考状态和轨迹-接触目标提升一致性。编辑阶段用类型化请求定义身体-时间范围与相对目标，由参考条件扩散编辑器配合采样期投影实现修改。实验显示语义对齐与动作质量提升，多轮相对编辑更可靠。
papers.abstract_en: Language-conditioned humanoid motion generation enables users to create and refine robot movements through natural language. The central challenge is to connect an underspecified request to concrete motion structure that can subsequently be revised relative to an accepted reference. We present TRACE, a generation and editing framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot built around typed, measurable kinematic quantities. Our insight is to ground generation conditions in paired training motions and editing goals in the current motion. A language model learns to predict support, root, and hand events from motion-derived supervision; their time-aligned encodings complement the original text in a diffusion generator. Gravity-referenced states and trajectory--contact objectives improve kinematic consistency. For editing, typed requests define body--time scopes and source-relative goals. A separate reference-conditioned diffusion editor uses these goals and revised events to realize changes, while sampling-time projection preserves protected state coordinates. Quantitative evaluation and human assessment show improved semantic alignment and motion quality over the compared methods. Controlled ablations support the value of motion-grounded conditioning and kinematic consistency, while multi-turn editing evaluations demonstrate more reliable execution of successive relative requests under shared preservation constraints. Together, these results support typed kinematic structure as a common basis for motion generation and reference-aware revision.

papers.title_en: Finite-Time Guarantees for Constrained Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
papers.authors: Valentina Zaccaria, Philip Jordan, Tingting Ni, Gian Antonio Susto, Maryam Kamgarpour
papers.evidence: 部分可观测下带安全代价约束的强化学习
papers.tldr: 研究部分可观测约束马尔可夫决策过程（CPOMDP）中的强化学习：智能体仅凭不完整状态信息，在成本约束下最大化奖励，且最优策略可能依赖任意长历史。方法用有限历史窗口近似POMDP，将窗口作为约束MDP状态，并设计原始-对偶算法。首次给出非渐近保证，同时约束平均奖励次优性与约束违反；在滤波稳定性下，近似误差随窗口长度几何衰减。部分可观测网格世界实验验证了方法有效性。
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning in constrained partially observable Markov decision processes (CPOMDPs), where an agent maximizes reward subject to a cost constraint using only incomplete information about the underlying state. The lack of state observability may require optimal policies to depend on arbitrarily long observation-action histories, making planning and learning challenging. We leverage recent advances in finite-memory approximations of POMDPs and represent finite history windows as states of a constrained MDP. We then develop a primal--dual algorithm that provides the first non-asymptotic guarantees that jointly bound average reward suboptimality and constraint violation in the original CPOMDP. A key challenge is that this finite-window approximation affects both reward values and the set of feasible policies. Under a filter-stability assumption, we derive bounds relating optimality and feasibility in the finite-state model to those in the original CPOMDP, with approximation errors that decay geometrically with the window length. Experiments in partially observable gridworlds demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching
papers.authors: Denis Blessing, Onur Celik, Gerhard Neumann
papers.evidence: 以评论家动作梯度做不动点迭代更新RL流策略
papers.tldr: 在最大熵和行为约束强化学习中，最优策略服从 Boltzmann 分布，该分布复杂多峰且难以采样；流匹配策略表达力强，却依赖训练数据，在线 RL 中通常不可得。为此，本文提出定点流匹配 FFM：利用目标流恒等式，将 actor 更新建模为定点迭代，并以 critic 的动作梯度作为回归目标，实现无需数据地训练和微调流策略。实验表明，FFM 既能在离线到在线场景微调预训练流策略，也能在在线 RL 中从零高效准确训练。该工作为无数据学习表达力强的流式策略提供了原则性方案。
papers.abstract_en: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.

papers.title_en: Region Aware Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks for Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Jack Roberts, Praneeth Tummala, Kavi Sarna, Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto
papers.evidence: 区域感知的通道注意力模块
papers.tldr: SE通过通道重标定增强卷积网络，但全局平均池化压缩空间结构，限制其在图像分割等密集预测中的效果。提出区域感知SE，用空间引导池化替代全局池化，按区域重标定通道，设计BASE、SPASE、MAPSE、PLEASE四个模块，分别基于规则网格、超像素、语义图和可学习软区域分配。每个通道按区域独立门控，像素注意力反映区域归属，连接通道与空间注意力。在CUB、DUTS、VOC、ADE20K分割与分类基准上，多数优于SE及空间-通道注意力方法。
papers.abstract_en: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules improve convolutional networks by modeling channel-wise dependencies, but global average pooling collapses spatial structure into a single per-channel descriptor, limiting their effectiveness for dense prediction tasks such as image segmentation. We generalize SE by replacing global pooling with spatially guided pooling, enabling region-aware channel recalibration through four modules with complementary cost profiles. BASE formalizes Tiled Squeeze-and-Excite using a regular grid; SPASE pools over SLIC superpixels for image-adaptive regions; MAPSE obtains regions from semantic maps produced by a frozen, general-purpose network; and PLEASE learns soft region assignments end-to-end through a lightweight assignment network. Each channel receives one gate per region, so attention at each pixel reflects its region membership, bridging channel and spatial attention. PLEASE also produces its soft assignments as a byproduct of the forward pass, providing structured spatial interpretability without post-hoc analysis. The modules offer complementary computational tradeoffs: some add essentially no parameters, while others add no measurable latency. Across binary segmentation on CUB, DUTS, and ECSSD, semantic segmentation on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, and classification on mini-ImageNet, our modules outperform SE and related spatial-channel attention variants on most benchmarks, achieving the majority of best results.

papers.title_en: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safety-Aware Haptic Shared Control in Surgical Robotics
papers.authors: Zihao Zhang, Karl Handwerker, Balint Varga
papers.evidence: 面向共享控制的带安全约束多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 手术机器人触觉共享控制需平衡操作者参与和几何安全，但安全约束对任务执行与力协调的影响仍不明确。作者将人机交互建模为集中训练、分散执行的双智能体合作马尔可夫博弈，用无模型多智能体强化学习联合适配策略，并对比MADDPG、rMAPPO与epigraph约束。仿真中rMAPPO回报和跟踪最佳，epigraph更保守、几何暴露更低；真人输入下固定阻抗更快且全部成功，固定epigraph命令最一致。该工作为触觉共享控制中人类控制表征与约束处理权衡提供基准。
papers.abstract_en: Haptic shared control in surgical robotics combines human-side and robot-side forces at a shared end effector while preserving operator involvement. However, the effects of geometric safety choices on task execution and force coordination remain unclear. We model the interaction as a two-agent cooperative Markov game under centralized training and decentralized execution, comparing learned human control with a task-tuned fixed-impedance baseline. This model-free multi-agent reinforcement learning framework supports joint policy adaptation without requiring a complete analytical interaction model. It compares MADDPG and rMAPPO with an epigraph-constrained approach under common geometric task definitions. In simulation, rMAPPO generally achieved the highest return and tracking performance, whereas the epigraph approach produced more conservative motions and lower geometric exposure, including no observed collision or dangerous-region exposure after geometry transfer. With real operator input, fixed-impedance-trained policies were faster and successful in all recorded trials. Policies trained with a learned partner exhibited greater command opposition, while the fixed epigraph condition produced the most aligned commands. This work provides a benchmark for studying human-control representation and constraint-handling trade-offs in haptic shared control.

papers.title_en: Towards learning-enhanced solvers for multi-parametric optimization
papers.authors: Dieter Teichrib, Fabian König, Moritz Schulze Darup
papers.evidence: 面向模型预测控制的多参数优化学习增强求解器
papers.tldr: 多参数优化问题广泛出现在模型预测控制中，神经网络已被用于加速求解，但如何把结构分析系统融入经典优化算法仍待探索。本文针对线性二次MPC中的多参数二次规划，利用最优步长在参数空间呈分段常数的性质，设计定制神经网络对标准对偶投影梯度法的步长进行参数相关微调。理论上分析了该学习增强求解器的关键性质，数值算例验证了其有效性。该工作为将学习系统集成到经典优化算法提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks (NNs) have been employed in various ways to accelerate the solution of multi-parametric optimization problems (OPs), which prominently arise in model predictive control (MPC). Early approaches focused on approximating the parametric solution (e.g., the optimal control law) directly by NNs. More recently, learning-based techniques have been used to emulate or enhance solver iterations. For the direct approximation of the parametric solution, it has been demonstrated that exploiting structural properties of the underlying OP facilitates the design of suitable NN architectures. In this paper, we show that structural analysis can also be leveraged to systematically integrate learning into classical optimization algorithms, thereby enhancing their performance.   We formalize our concept for the case of multi-parametric quadratic programs (mpQPs), which frequently arise in linear-quadratic MPC, as a representative application. More precisely, we demonstrate that tailored NNs enable a parameter-dependent fine-tuning of the step sizes in a standard dual projected gradient scheme. The design of the NNs is guided by the observation that optimal step sizes, which permit obtaining the exact optimal solution in finitely many iterations, are piecewise constant functions over the parameter space (e.g., the state space in MPC). We establish key theoretical properties of the proposed approach and illustrate its effectiveness in a numerical case study.

papers.title_en: Task-Space Motion-Force Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Precise and Compliant Control under Uncertainties
papers.authors: Quang-Nam Nguyen, Ludovic Righetti
papers.evidence: 非线性模型预测控制求解最优控制问题实现机器人运动与力控制
papers.tldr: 传统NMPC控制律由最优控制问题隐式决定，OCP设计常需针对平台与任务大量调参，且将交互视为刚性接触，使力矩对建模误差敏感。本文提出统一任务空间NMPC框架，直接规划控制关节，满足运动与力要求，并可跨平台任务泛化。该框架借助内在任务空间阻抗、部分收缩性及微分无源性，在高层规划层闭合力反馈环，实现精确运动-力跟踪。在冗余机械臂与四足机器人硬件上验证混合运动-力控制与柔顺运动，并保持硬约束满足、冗余利用与实时规划优势。
papers.abstract_en: In Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), the control law is implicitly determined by the solution of an Optimal Control Problem (OCP). Consequently, OCP design is often tailored to specific platforms and tasks, demanding extensive expert knowledge and tuning effort. To address this, we propose a unified NMPC framework that directly plans and controls the robot joints subject to task-space motion and force requirements and is capable of seamlessly generalizing across multiple robotic platforms and diverse tasks. Furthermore, optimization-based methods often treat interactions as rigid contacts, making the torque solution sensitive to the modeling errors of the robot dynamics and the environment. We study the intrinsic task-space impedance of our proposed controller, its partial contraction for differential stability and differential passivity under unmodeled interactions. As a result, our framework enables closing the force-feedback loop in the high-level planning layer to achieve precise motion-force tracking performance, addressing the long-standing challenge of force-feedback NMPC. Finally, we validate our framework on physical hardware, demonstrating hybrid motion-force control on a redundant manipulator and compliant locomotion on a quadruped, while preserving core NMPC advantages such as hard constraint satisfaction, optimal redundancy exploitation, and real-time planning under unforeseen interactions.

papers.title_en: Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.authors: Lingfan Bao, Hanshang Zhu, Yan Pan, Jincheng Wang, Jingyang Yu, Tianhu Peng, Yiyang Jia, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Chengxu Zhou
papers.evidence: 通过残差学习保留表现性运动特征的人形机器人全身控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身控制不仅要完成动作，还需保留其表达特征；现有跟踪器偏重关节/关键点误差与稳定性，平均位置误差更低未必意味着动态与姿态特征保持更好。本文提出残差学习框架，以幅度、能量、身体扩张、身体倾斜和骨盆高度为补偿目标，并用运动感知门控按身体部位活跃度分配修正能力。针对每个冻结跟踪器训练动作特定残差策略，再蒸馏为跨动作类别共享的统一策略。在Unitree G1八类动作的仿真与实物实验中，动态和姿态特征的保持效果优于基线。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body control plays a crucial role in enabling humanoid robots to execute expressive motions. Faithful execution requires preserving both the intended action and its expressive characteristics. Existing whole-body trackers typically balance joint and keypoint tracking with physical stability across diverse motions, but these objectives do not necessarily prioritize the expressive characteristics of each action. Our analysis shows that lower average positional tracking error does not guarantee better preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics. To address this gap, we propose a residual learning framework with compensation objectives targeting amplitude, energy, body expansion, body lean, and pelvis height. To concentrate compensation while limiting interference with the underlying tracking behavior, motion-aware gating allocates correction capacity according to body-part activity, preserving larger correction ranges in more active parts and restricting them elsewhere. For each frozen tracker, we train motion-specific residual policies and distill them into a unified policy shared across motion categories. Simulation and physical experiments on the Unitree G1 across eight motion categories demonstrate superior preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics compared with the corresponding baselines.

papers.title_en: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
papers.authors: Hyunsik Oh, Seunghun Jeon, Donghoon Youm, Jungwoo Hur, Hyeongjun Kim, Jeong Hyun Lee, Moonkyu Jung, Jemin Hwangbo
papers.evidence: 面向异构腿式机器人的强化学习运动策略
papers.tldr: 强化学习虽能实现腿式机器人鲁棒运动，但策略通常绑定特定形态，腿数、执行器或机械属性变化需重新工程。PolyMorph 将 URDF 解析为关节-连杆模块，结合循环编码器、图 Transformer 与逐关节解码器，生成跨腿数和关节配置的动作。它采用形态归一化奖励、自适应机器人采样和 URDF 派生 PD 增益初始化提升训练稳定性。仿真覆盖双足、三足、四足及未见形态，并部署于真实四足平台，单一策略无需逐机器人重训即可泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

papers.title_en: Spatiotemporal Response Decay for Near-Optimal Distributed LQR via System Level Synthesis
papers.authors: Chenchen Zhou, José Matias
papers.evidence: 基于系统级综合的分布式LQR最优控制及响应时空衰减界
papers.tldr: 分布式LQR需权衡信息传播范围与记忆时长。本文基于系统级综合（SLS），为每个节点给定相对集中式控制的性能损失，推导通信与存储资源上界。对局部耦合系统，在可稳/可检等正则假设下证明最优扰动响应随时间和空间距离指数衰减。多项式邻域增长网络中，所需通信半径与记忆窗仅随容差倒数对数增长，与网络规模无关；截断响应可得局部有限记忆滤波器，并给出稳定性与性能保证。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed control requires choosing how far information travels and how long it is retained. For networked linear quadratic regulation (LQR), we use System Level Synthesis to bound these resources for a specified performance loss per node relative to centralized control. For locally coupled systems under uniform regularity assumptions, including stabilizability and detectability, we prove that the centralized optimal state and input responses to disturbance impulses satisfy exponential decay bounds in both time and spatial distance. On networks with polynomial neighborhood growth, sufficient communication ranges and memory horizons grow logarithmically with the inverse tolerance, independently of network size. Truncating these responses gives local finite-memory filters with stability and performance guarantees under a computable small-gain condition. Under an additional uniform local feedback condition, we also obtain controllers that confine nominal disturbance effects in space and eliminate them in finite time. Numerical experiments illustrate how performance and disturbance containment requirements guide architecture selection.

papers.title_en: Learning minimum-time navigation policies in two-dimensional flows with a genetic algorithm
papers.authors: Vladimir Parfenyev
papers.evidence: 学习最小时间导航策略并复现最优控制解，与Q学习及演员-评论家方法比较
papers.tldr: 针对已知二维流场中固定滑移速度、可调方向船舶的最短时间导航问题，提出用神经网络参数化导航策略，并以无交叉的遗传算法通过选择与参数变异进化策略集合。该方法在多个基准及二维湍流中复现解析和数值最优控制解，且优于Q-learning与一步actor-critic。学习策略对起点变化和未解析小尺度湍流扰动具有鲁棒性，只要扰动特征速度远小于船舶滑移速度。其表示紧凑、易并行且无需奖励塑形，为复杂流场最短时间轨迹计算提供了高效替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: We study minimum-time navigation between two points in a known two-dimensional fluid flow for a vessel with fixed-magnitude slip velocity and controllable direction. The navigation policy is parameterized by a neural network and optimized using a genetic algorithm that evolves an ensemble of candidate strategies through Darwinian selection and parameter mutation, without crossover. The method recovers analytical and numerical optimal-control solutions in several benchmark cases, including two-dimensional turbulence, and outperforms Q-learning and one-step actor-critic method. We further show that the learned navigation strategies are robust to variations in the starting position and to unresolved small-scale turbulent fluctuations, provided that the characteristic velocity of these fluctuations remains small compared to the vessel's slip velocity. The proposed approach provides a compact representation of the navigation policy, is readily parallelizable, and eliminates the need for reward shaping, offering an efficient alternative to existing analytical and numerical methods for computing minimum-time trajectories in complex flows.

papers.title_en: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
papers.authors: Minghao Fu, Tavis Siebert, Eryk Halicki, Randall Balestriero
papers.evidence: 面向控制与规划的端到端潜空间世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有JEPA通常先训练视觉表征与动作条件动力学，再外接控制策略或求解器，难以端到端联合优化。LeWAM提出面向控制的端到端JEPA，将下一隐状态预测与动作流匹配联合训练，并对隐状态施加各向同性高斯约束。单一模型既能直接执行策略，又能利用学习到的隐动力学评估采样动作进行高效规划。在接触丰富任务中成功率从28.6%升至89.7%，长时程任务从10.9%升至46.2%，规划速度提升32.3倍，并在仿真与真实机器人行为克隆中具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.

papers.title_en: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL
papers.authors: Zhicheng Cai, Weinan Dai, Yuyan Zhou, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Hao Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向长时程强化学习的策略优化
papers.tldr: 长程自回归 rollout 中，局部策略失配会沿轨迹累积为严重的状态分布偏移，而 GRPO、GSPO 等只在 token 或序列层面控制失配，导致训练随 horizon 增长而不稳定甚至崩溃。TAPO 从 off-policy 策略梯度理论推导出状态分布修正项并融入 RL 目标，辅以几何均值估计降方差和长度感知动态裁剪。在八个竞赛级基准上，数学推理较 GRPO 最高提升 48%，算法编程提升 12%，训练稳定性显著增强。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.

papers.title_en: Structure-Aware Numerical Stabilization for Half-Precision Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Linxuan Wu, Liang Chen
papers.evidence: 半精度PPO数值稳定化
papers.tldr: 资源受限平台需低开销在线训练，但PPO直接转FP16会因数值误差在策略更新和数据收集中反馈而失稳。作者提出PPO-FP16，用全局标量保护、策略变化残差保护和持久更新保护三类结构感知模块，稳定共享统计量、行为策略差异与优化器写回。六个连续控制任务、五个种子下，其平均回报AUC排名最低1.90，30组中17组第一，九种配置中八种更新加速1.16–2.03倍，优化器状态内存降71.7%–74.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Local online training on resource-constrained platforms requires low computational and training-state overhead. We study the numerical stability and computational efficiency of half-precision proximal policy optimization (PPO) on commodity GPUs. Directly converting PPO training to FP16 is unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and subsequent data collection, while PPO repeatedly compares a current policy with a fixed behavior policy. We propose PPO-FP16 with three structure-aware modules. Global scalar protection stabilizes statistics shared across a minibatch or parameter update. Policy-change residual protection extracts and preserves small differences between the current and behavior policies. Efficient persistent-update protection stabilizes optimizer state and parameter writeback while reducing state storage. These changes preserve the PPO objective, hyperparameters, and training budget. Across six continuous-control tasks and five seeds, PPO-FP16 achieves the lowest mean return-AUC rank (1.90) among the four methods and ranks first in 17 of 30 environment-seed comparisons. Eight of nine performance configurations yield PPO update speedups ranging from 1.16 to 2.03 times. Relative to Full FP32 Adam, optimizer-state memory is reduced by 71.7 to 74.9 percent, and peak allocated GPU memory is reduced by up to 44.5 percent. The results show that protecting a small set of structurally important quantities can deliver stable, efficient FP16 PPO without retuning.

papers.title_en: Evo-RL: Iterative Robot Reinforcement Learning from Selective Experience
papers.authors: Kai Ye, Yifan Jin, Qianhang Luo, Hongru Zhang, Jiedong Zhang, Shuyuan Hu, Song-Yuan Wu, Jihai Xu, Jie Zhao, Bo Zhao
papers.evidence: 结合人类纠正与优势引导经验筛选的迭代机器人强化学习
papers.tldr: 真实机器人强化学习通常结合人工修正与自主探索来提升策略，但累积经验价值不一，成功轨迹也可能包含低效或冗余行为。Evo-RL提出迭代式强化学习，利用人工干预与基于优势估计的正优势经验筛选，选择性复用高价值经验来持续优化策略。作者还构建了覆盖四类机器人本体、超1000小时的RW-RL-Dataset。在高精度真实操作任务上，Evo-RL相较RECAP将尝试成功率提升30.46%，验证了选择性经验复用与迭代学习的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Existing real-world reinforcement learning methods improve robot policies by combining human corrections with autonomous rollouts. However, accumulated experience varies in its value for policy improvement, and even successful trajectories can contain inefficient or redundant behavior, motivating more selective experience reuse. To this end, we propose Evo-RL, an iterative reinforcement learning method that combines human interventions with advantage-guided experience selection. Evo-RL uses human corrections and experience with positive estimated advantages from successful trajectories to iteratively refine the policy. To support learning from these different experience sources, we introduce RW-RL-Dataset, which spans over 1,000 hours across four robot embodiments. On a real-world high-precision manipulation task, Evo-RL improves attempt success rate over RECAP by 30.46\%. Our code, model checkpoints, and dataset are publicly available.

papers.title_en: PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.authors: Jie Yang, Mianqiu Huang, Yiwei Zhao, Bo Wang, Yang Liu, Yuxin Wang
papers.evidence: 改进局部信用分配的强化学习策略优化
papers.tldr: 多轮智能体仅靠终端奖励即可训练，但组相对优势难以定位中间决策，且失败轨迹常含合理动作，不利模式会反复出现。PEARL 无需额外 critic，比较同一历史的两条不同结果续写，定位首次分歧并构造局部分支决策特征，聚类近期成败记忆以识别复发模式。它选择性增强低奖励决策的负优势，保留正优势与基础优化器。AppWorld 上 4B/8B 均优于 ARPO，ALFWorld 4B 平均成功率达 97.9%，超最强基线 2.7 点，贡献在于实现选择性、复发模式驱动的局部信用分配。
papers.abstract_en: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.
